variants.source:
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/workspaces/{workspace_id}/agents/{agent_id}")
async def get_agent(
    workspace_id: str,
    agent_id: str,
    user = Depends(require_workspace_member),
):
    svc = AgentService()
    agent = await svc.get(agent_id, workspace_id=workspace_id)
    return agent
variants.rationale: The service lookup scopes the acted resource to the same workspace authorized by the dependency.
